description: Misinformation firewall — common rumors and ECI-verified facts

rumors.myth: EVMs can be hacked remotely via WiFi or Bluetooth
rumors.fact: EVMs are completely air-gapped stand-alone machines. They have NO WiFi, Bluetooth, or internet connectivity. Remote hacking is physically impossible.
rumors.source: Election Commission of India — Official EVM FAQ

rumors.myth: Polling has been cancelled in your area
rumors.fact: The Election Commission announces all polling changes officially through eci.gov.in and authorized media. Always verify with your District Election Officer before believing forwarded messages.

rumors.myth: The indelible ink can be washed off, allowing double voting
rumors.fact: Electoral ink contains silver nitrate and is manufactured by Mysore Paints & Varnish Ltd under strict quality control. It penetrates the nail bed and stays visible for 4-6 weeks. Double-voting is also prevented by electronic checks.

rumors.myth: EVMs come pre-loaded with votes for a specific party
rumors.fact: Before every election, a mandatory mock poll of 1,000+ votes is conducted in front of all party agents. The machine is cleared and sealed only after agents verify zero starting count.

rumors.myth: EVMs are secretly swapped before counting day
rumors.fact: After polling, EVMs are sealed with unique serial numbers and stored in strong rooms under 24/7 CCTV and armed guard. Political party agents can observe and camp outside. Any seal tampering is immediately detectable.

rumors.myth: There is no paper trail for EVM votes
rumors.fact: Every EVM is paired with a VVPAT (Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail) machine that prints a paper slip for each vote, visible for 7 seconds. VVPAT slips of 5 randomly selected booths per constituency are mandatorily cross-verified with EVM counts.
rumors.source: Supreme Court of India — VVPAT Order 2019
